title: Prompt → Context → Harness: The 3 Levels of AI Mastery
subtitle: Most people stop at prompting. Better users master context. The best users build systems.
content:
# The 3 Levels of AI Mastery

Most people only ever reach Level 1. Here is what the full picture looks like.

---

# Level 1 — Prompt Engineering (Beginner)

This is what most people focus on.

## What it is

* Writing better prompts
* Giving clear instructions
* Structuring requests

## Examples

* "Explain like I'm 10"
* "Step-by-step solution"
* "Act as a senior developer"

> **Limitation:** Only works well for simple, one-off tasks.

---

# Level 2 — Context Engineering (Intermediate)

This is where things get much more powerful.

## What it is

* Controlling what the AI "knows" during a task
* Feeding it: documents, memory, codebase, history

> **Key idea:** AI is only as good as the context you give it.

## Examples

* Providing project files before asking questions
* Giving structured background info
* Maintaining session memory across tasks

> **Why it matters:** Enables accurate, relevant, consistent outputs.

---

# Level 3 — Harness Engineering (Advanced)

This is the most important and least understood layer.

## What it is

* Building a **system** around the AI
* Creating workflows, tools, and automation
* Turning AI into a team member with tools

## Examples

* Multi-step pipelines (plan → execute → review)
* Tool use (search, code execution, APIs)
* Agent systems

> **This is where real productivity gains happen.**

---

# Key Differences

* **Prompt** — How you ask — Low power — Simple tasks
* **Context** — What AI knows — Medium power — Complex tasks
* **Harness** — System around AI — High power — Real workflows

---

# Best Tips by Level

## Prompt Tips
* Be specific and structured
* Use roles ("act as…")
* Ask for step-by-step reasoning

## Context Tips
* Always provide relevant background
* Keep context clean and focused
* Avoid overload — too much info = worse results

## Harness Tips
* Break work into stages (plan → build → refine)
* Use tools instead of doing everything in one prompt
* Automate repeatable workflows

## Workflow Tips
* Don't rely on one big prompt
* Iterate in loops
* Treat AI like a collaborator, not a tool

---

# Advanced Insights

* Prompting alone is becoming outdated
* Context is the **fuel** of AI
* Harness design is the real competitive advantage

---

# Final Takeaway

* Most people stop at prompting
* Better users master context
* The best users build systems

> **Stop thinking in prompts — start thinking in systems.**
